# reminder trigger

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:reminderTrigger`](gmeow-reminderTrigger.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/reminderTrigger>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The trigger for a reminder — either an [xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) offset before the target event (e.g. PT15M) or an absolute [xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to set when a reminder fires — an [xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) offset before its target event (PT15M, P1D) for the common case, or an absolute [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) for a fixed alert time.

### Avoid when

- Avoid writing an offset as a bare number or a date (the range is the [xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) ∪ [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) union — use PT15M, not 15) and avoid using it as the target event's own time.

### How to use

- Write an [xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) for an offset-from-target trigger or an [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) for an absolute one; the offset is resolved against the [`gmeow:reminderTarget`](gmeow-reminderTarget.md) event's start.

### Examples

- ex:standupAlarm [`gmeow:reminderTrigger`](gmeow-reminderTrigger.md) "PT15M"^^[xsd:duration.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration.)
